description: r/diydrones critique of PETGasus v0.1, paraphrased: tall ducts, cutouts, flat planks, no gussets, crash durability, filament choice

extractions.what: ducts too tall (keep a guard to 4 mm or less), windows make propwash and add weight
flat planks and right angles with no gussets: stress concentrators at every joint; fillet horizontally, chamfer vertically
it will fly but break after a couple of crashes; PETG-CF too brittle, PETG too soft; choose the filament as part of the design
